1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Witsemba.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi yitwa Mikitamu.

2.text: Mbese guceceka ni ko mucisha imanza zitabera?Mwa bantu mwe, mbese muca imanza z'ukuri?

3.text: Ahubwo mukorera ibyo gukiranirwa mu mitima yanyu,Urugomo rw'amaboko yanyu ni rwo rubanza mucira mu gihugu.

4.text: Abanyabyaha batandukanywa n'Imana uhereye ku kuvuka kwabo,Iyo bavutse uwo mwanya bariyobagiza bakabeshya.

5.text: Ubusabwe bwabo buhwanye n'ubw'inzoka,Bameze nk'impoma y'igipfamatwi yiziba amatwi,

6.text: Itumva ijwi ry'abagombozi,Naho bagomboresha ubwenge bwinshi cyane.

7.text: Mana, ubavune amenyo mu kanwa kabo,Uwiteka, uce imikaka y'iyo migunzu y'intare.

8.text: Buzuruke bakame nk'amazi asuma cyane,Agitamika imyambi ibe nk'ibishishibano.

9.text: Babe nk'ikijongororwa kiyaga kigashira,Babe nk'ikiramb, kitigeze kureba izuba.

10.text: Inkono zanyu zitarashyushywa n'umuriro w'amahwa,Imana izayajyanisha serwakira, amabisi n'acanywe byose.

11.text: Umukiranutsi azishima nabona uko guhōra,Azogesha ibirenge bye amaraso y'abanyabyaha.

12.text: Bizatuma abantu bavuga bati“Ni ukuri hariho ingororano y'abakiranutsi,Ni ukuri hariho Imana icira imanza mu isi.”
